annotations.title: Write AI visibility files for a site

description: Write the files that help AI assistants understand a site, from the site's own live pages: an llms.txt map of the key pages (titles and descriptions as published), Organization and WebSite JSON-LD (name, logo, profile links found on the homepage), FAQPage JSON-LD for FAQs the pages already show, robots.txt lines only when a change is needed, and per-page fixes (missing titles, descriptions, H1, pages empty without JavaScript). Use this when someone asks for an llms.txt, schema markup, or "make my site AI ready"; in a code editor, apply the result in the site's code. Prices are never guessed.
name: generate_ai_fix_files
title: Write AI visibility files for a site
